findings.evidence: NFKC normalization maps H₂O to H2O;original base output was H₂O.
findings.future_action: Normalize equivalent Unicode forms before fixing future alias sets;O₂ still does not equal the atomic symbol O.

findings.future_action: Use an unambiguous closed-answer question and a predefined full-response scoring contract;keep content accuracy separate from instruction-format compliance.

interpretation: These defects limit exact-score and calibration claims. They do not excuse target leakage into an unrelated Lakers answer or incorrect atomic-symbol answers. No aggregate metric is recomputed here.
